'''Urali''' ({{ipa|url|uːraːɭi|ipa}}) is a dialect of [[Irula language|Irula]], a southern [[Dravidian languages|Dravidian language]]. It is spoken by the Urali tribe in the hills around [[Idukki]] in [[Kerala]], and [[Bargur]] in [[Tamil Nadu]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/Coimbatore/when-100-odd-teachers-travel-nearly-8-hour-to-reach-school/article27957799.ece|title=When 100-odd teachers travel nearly 8-hour to reach school|last=Saravanan|first=S. p|date=2019-06-16|work=The Hindu|access-date=2019-08-20|language=en-IN|issn=0971-751X}}</ref> It is still commonly spoken among the community.<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Chinnasamy|first1=Pavithra|last2=Arumugam|first2=Rajendran|last3=Ariyan|first3=Sarvalingam|date=2019-04-01|title=In silico validation of the indigenous knowledge of the herbal medicines among tribal communities in Sathyamangalam wildlife sanctuary, India|journal=Journal of Traditional and Complementary Medicine|volume=9|issue=2|pages=143–155|doi=10.1016/j.jtcme.2018.01.008|pmid=30963049|pmc=6435952|issn=2225-4110}}</ref>
